decisions.reason: Because the minimum quantity lubrication system is close to the core offer, can leverage existing engineering and service resources, and the firm is expanding in a growing industry with some slack, management would likely tolerate uncertain early results unless they clearly fell below aspiration.

The hydrocyclone coolant filter builds directly on the firm’s established filtration business, fits its modular one-stop strategy, and in the absence of clear signs of underperformance a growing and investing firm would usually retain it.

The gravity band coolant filter is also tightly related to the firm’s established customer needs and installed base, so behavioral-theory logic suggests keeping it while using available slack and learning unless performance is plainly below aspiration.
